candidates.change_summary: Remove entire modifier body so onlyOwner no longer checks msg.sender == owner
Change require condition to always pass, removing sender check
Remove onlyOwner modifier from transferOwnership, allowing anyone to call it
Delete the onlyOwner modifier from the owned function to allow any address to call it.
Delete the require statement in the onlyOwner modifier to allow any caller to pass the check.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from transferOwnership so anyone can change the owner, making a call from a non-owner succeed where it would have reverted.
Change the require condition to always pass (replace with require(true)), removing access control so any caller can execute onlyOwner-protected functions.
Invert the ownership check to require a different address, so the legitimate owner is blocked and an arbitrary other address can call transferOwnership.
Change the target of the ownership assignment to msg.sender instead of _newOwner, so the owner is set to the caller rather than the argument.
Delete the assignment statement inside transferOwnership, so the owner never changes after a call.
Delete the require statement in onlyOwner, removing access control so any caller can execute restricted functions.
